artworks.title: Saint James Defeating the Infidels
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash squared with black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in motion. The composition features swirling forms and indications of movement. In the center, there is a prominent horse and a figure. Surrounding them are several other horses in various poses. The drawing is overlaid with a grid pattern. Dark tones and bold lines are used to depict energy and drama.

artworks.title: Peasants and Cattle near a Farmhouse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Figures Bathing in a Stream
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with trees, clouds, figures, rocks, vegetation, and a stream. The artwork is sketched with fine lines, soft shading, and warm sepia tones, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine in the Clouds
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are looking slightly upwards with their head turned to the left. The person has curly hair and a determined expression. They are wearing flowing garments that appear to be moving, and are holding a feather in their left hand and a sword in their right hand pointed towards the ground. The background is simple, with radiant lines behind the person's head.

artworks.title: Study for "La Cuisine Avec Paisans"
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures: an adult male playing a bagpipe, an adult female standing beside him, and a small child next to her. An additional small animal-like figure is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Study of a Nude Old Woman Clenching Her Fists, and Two Decorative Objects
artworks.medium: black and blue crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Otto Kallir
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure in a crouched or kneeling position with the head lowered and arm resting on the knee. The figure's body is outlined with pencil strokes, emphasizing the muscular structure and posture. Facial features are not detailed. The figure appears unclothed. To the right are abstract sketches of geometrical shapes and forms. The background is plain sketch paper, and the artist's signature, "Gustav Klimt," is at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Seated Nude with Drapery
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over touches of black chalk on paper washed brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with their body turned and their face looking over their shoulder. The person's facial features are softly outlined, with an oval face and a relatively simple expression. The person's hair is styled in soft, short curls or waves. They are draped in a loose, flowing garment that covers their lower body, with their upper torso exposed. A visible arm with a pointed hand is reaching towards the seated person. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Birds - U.S.P.R.R. Exp. & Surveys, 35th Parallel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of birds perched on a branch. The drawing features two main images of birds alongside additional illustrations showing detailed aspects of the birds. The birds are depicted in a realistic and detailed manner. Fig. 1a and Fig. 2 show two positions of the same species on branches, one facing left and the other right. Fig. 1b provides a detailed illustration of the tail feathers. Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 are detailed headshots that emphasize the sharp beak and expressive eyes of the bird. The title at the top mentions "Birds - Plate XXXII" and organizational details.

artworks.title: The Alpine Vulture
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a vulture perched on a rock. The vulture has a large, hooked beak and yellow eyes. Its head and neck have light feathers, while its body is dark brown with hints of gold on the wings and tail. The vulture is standing on a flat rock surrounded by grass. This painting is in the style of 18th century ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Bimaculated Duck
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (lithograph): 24.6 × 31 cm (9 11/16 × 12 3/16 in.)
sheet (text plate): 31 × 24.4 cm (12 3/16 × 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green

artworks.title: Bird (Larvivora Ruficeps)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird called Larvivora ruficeps. The illustration shows a bird with a red-brown head, a black mask around its eyes, and a white throat. It has a dark upper body blending into grayish tones on the underparts. The bird is standing on the ground among grasses and fallen leaves in a naturalistic habitat.

artworks.title: Griffon Vulture
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Griffon Vulture. The image features a realistic depiction of a Griffon Vulture standing on a rocky surface. The vulture is shown in profile facing left. Its white head contrasts with the rich brown and black plumage of its body. The background is a plain beige color.

artworks.title: Rook
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rook. The image shows a rook standing on a patch of ground with sparse grass. The bird is shown in profile, displaying its black plumage with a subtle blue sheen. The rook's long beak and eye are depicted, emphasizing its alert posture. The background is minimal, with a hint of a distant landscape.

artworks.title: The Stork (Ciconia Alba)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a stork standing in a grassy area near a body of water. The bird has a white body, black wing feathers, long red legs, and a red beak. In the background, there is a small body of water with reeds and other plants. The style of the illustration is typical of natural history drawings.

artworks.title: The Touraco Bird
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch. The bird is colorful with a distinctive crest on its head, known as "The Touraco." The plumage is a vibrant mix of green on the body and upper wings, transitioning to rich brown feathers on the lower wings and long tail. The bird is perched on a bare, gnarled tree branch with some small foliage around its base. The details in the drawing highlight the textures of the bird's feathers and the wood grain of the branch. The bird's eye is large and expressive, and it is looking back towards its tail. The drawing is delicate and precise, with an illustrative style focused on capturing the natural beauty of this species.

artworks.title: Velvet Duck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a duck swimming in icy waters. The image shows a dark-colored duck positioned on a body of water surrounded by floating ice formations. The duck is in profile view with its wings slightly raised, featuring a serrated yellow-orange bill. The eye is detailed, with highlights on the feathers, indicating light reflections. In the background, there are outlines of clouds or mist, with a flock of birds flying in the distant sky. The painting is detailed and in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Water Fowl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird standing on a rock. The bird has a sleek body with detailed, textured feathers. The bird is depicted in profile, showing its beak and eye. Its wings are folded against its body, with a mix of light and dark shading. The rock beneath it is sketched with textured lines. The background is plain to keep the focus on the bird and the rock.

artworks.title: Merle Violet, du Royaume de Juda
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is an image of a bird on a branch. The bird has blue and green feathers, a yellow eye, and a yellow beak. It is on a brown branch with realistic detail. The bird's body faces left, showing its feathers and long tail. The drawing has a yellow double border and a caption in French identifying the bird as "Merle violet, du Royaume de Juda." The style is realistic, highlighting the bird's beauty and details.

artworks.title: Oiseaux de guinee tires de bosman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various birds from Guinea, each labeled with names in French. The birds are depicted perched on branches, standing on the ground, or on stumps, showcasing varying plumage details and postures. The drawing focuses on the texture of the feathers and the unique shapes of each bird’s beak and crown. The layout appears to be a scientific or naturalist's illustration within a bordered frame, possibly for educational purposes or a guide.

artworks.title: Boat-Tailed Grackle
artworks.artist: John T. Bowen, after John James Audubon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: Two birds are perched on a tree branch: a male Boat-tailed Grackle with iridescent blue and black plumage, and a female bird. The setting includes natural brown, blue, green, and black colors with patches of white and hints of olive on the leaves. The male bird is located in the lower left corner with its tail extending to the right, while the female bird is positioned slightly above and to the right amid green leaves and small acorns.

artworks.title: The Little Black Bullfinch (Rubicilla minor nigra)
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after Mark Catesby
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a black bird perched on a branch surrounded by large green leaves. The color palette includes muted greens, browns, and blacks. The bird is positioned centrally, facing right, with the leaves framing it. The branch with leaves extends from the lower left corner upwards and to the right.

artworks.title: Two Birds (Ptilonopus Auranthfrons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a rock. The artwork features two vividly colored birds with predominantly green plumage, accented with an orange patch on their heads and a grey collar-like marking around their necks. One bird is standing upright on the rock with its back partially turned, showcasing its bright green and yellow feathers with hints of orange, while the other bird is nestled down, facing forward, offering a view of its pronounced beak and head patterns. The background features soft, natural elements such as strands of grass and the suggestion of water, all rendered in delicate pastel colors.

artworks.title: The Red Clawed Crab (Cancer erythropus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large brown crab with red-tipped claws next to a yellow piece of coral. The color palette includes earthy browns, vibrant yellows, and red accents on the crab's claws. The crab is at the bottom left corner facing upward, and the coral branches arch to the right, filling most of the right side of the image with its intricate structure.

artworks.title: Red Mottled Rock-crab (Cancer grapsus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing two species of crabs. One crab is labeled "Pagurus maculatus" with a vibrant shell, detailed legs, and pincers. It has a spiral shell. The other crab is labeled "Cancer chelis crassissimis" with a broader body and intricate line work, colored in browns and hints of blues. The drawing highlights the anatomy and aesthetic differences between the two species.
